lines.en: My loose threads trail and sway behind me.
I drift along, never quite touching the ground.

lines.zh: 翅膀一样的破布呼啦作响。
lines.en: My rag wings flap with a dry rustle.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶慢慢飘过去。
lines.en: I drift slowly over your head.
My cotton core whispers as I move.

lines.zh: 我拖着线头飘过整条走廊。
lines.en: I drift the length of the corridor with my thread trailing.

lines.zh: 这身体轻得像一件旧衣服。
lines.en: This body is light as an old shirt.
I lift a little on the air current.

lines.zh: 纽扣眼睛一直在看外面。
lines.en: My button eyes never stop looking out.
I settle, then bob up again.
I float along your footprints.

lines.zh: 缝线在空气里拉得笔直。
lines.en: My seams pull taut in the air.
I tilt and stuffing pushes out.
I hang in the air, swaying.

lines.zh: 一只纽扣松了，我按住它。
lines.en: A button came loose; I press it back.
Fluff drifts from a tear in me.
I turn my head slowly to look at you.

lines.zh: 纽扣眼对着墙，我假装睡着。
lines.en: My button eye faces the wall; I pretend to sleep.

lines.zh: 棉絮漏了一点，我还飘得动。
lines.en: A little stuffing leaks out, but I can still float.
I wait for your word.
My seams tangle around a finger.

lines.zh: 洞里的东西我还没想明白。
lines.en: I have not worked out what is inside me.
I drift lower and brush the ground.
The old smell of cloth still lingers.
I blink eyes that are not really eyes.
I fold one of my rag wings.
I am good. Do not throw me away.

lines.zh: 静下来的时候，线头在抖。
lines.en: At rest, my loose threads tremble.
Will you keep me with you?
I was not like this before.
One strike of flint and steel, and I changed.
Do not point scissors at me.

lines.zh: 我飘在你旁边，是因为想。
lines.en: I float at your side because I wish to.
My eyes are made of buttons.

lines.zh: 我记得你抱着我的样子。
lines.en: I remember the way you held me.
Your hands smell of cotton thread.
I am not so pretty now, am I?
I can feel you hesitating.
Do not poke my seam; I might come apart.

lines.zh: 我们一起去打点什么吧。
lines.en: Let us go hit something together.

lines.zh: 我绕着你慢慢转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle you once, slowly.
I am happier when you smile.

lines.zh: 我悬停在跟你眼睛齐平的地方。
lines.en: I hover level with your eyes.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，缝线都绷开了。
lines.en: I circle you; my seams pull tight.
Point at a target and it is done.
Whenever you look back, I am there.

lines.zh: 你手里的熔岩桶，我认得。
lines.en: I know that bucket of lava in your hand.
My seam came loose — will you mend it?
A seam split and my stuffing leaks out.
I hardly hurt, but I am very sad.
I lurch aside and right myself slowly.
Do not tear me; I will come apart.
A button has fallen to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的破布撕开一道口子。
lines.en: A rent opens in my rags.
I retreat and curl into a ball.
Fluff leaks from where it hurts.
I shake myself; I held together.
You hit me. Why?
Lava? You are sure you want to give me that?
It is hot. I like it a lot.
I lean to the bucket's rim and smell scorching.
Pour a little. Do not splash me.

lines.zh: 棉花快烤焦了，可是好暖。
lines.en: My cotton is singeing, but it is so warm.
Will you leave a little for me?
This smell makes me feel alive.
I lean in, then pull back.
If I eat this, will I change shape?

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，里面全是线。
lines.en: I open my mouth; it is full of thread.

lines.zh: 一小口就够我消化很久。
lines.en: One small gulp will keep me busy a long while.
Steady your hand; it is scalding.

lines.zh: 我咽下去了，肚子里在响。
lines.en: I swallowed it, and my belly is rumbling.
It is not food, but I can eat it.

lines.zh: 给我一块，我能吐回一块肉。
lines.en: Give me some and I can cough up mutton.

lines.zh: 我盯着桶里发红的东西。
lines.en: I stare at the glowing stuff in the bucket.
So fragrant, so hot, so lovely.
Bump me and you will bounce off.
I have no weight, only cotton.
The bump knocked my cloth crooked.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的那一下很轻。
lines.en: Your bump was very light.
I tip over and slowly right myself.
Do not squash me flat.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，棉絮落了一地。
lines.en: I shake myself and fluff falls everywhere.
My thread has snagged your clothes.
I drift aside to make room.
Even after the bump, I am still smiling.
I circle and charge; watch closely.

lines.zh: 受重击的时候我会闪到对面。
lines.en: When hit hard, I slip to the other side.
Let us circle it together.
You hit once; I ram twice.
I can fly — look.
Help me wind my thread back.
When I tire, I lean against your leg.

lines.zh: 别把我和别的玩偶放一起。
lines.en: Do not put me with the other dolls.
We work well together.
Leave the last blow to me.
I snagged it with a loose thread.
Can this go inside my stuffing?

lines.zh: 我把东西藏在肚子缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it into the seam of my belly.
I picked it up. Here.
I am slow. Do not rush me.
This is a bit hot to hold.
Holding it to my chest, I fly unsteadily.

lines.zh: 掉了就是找不到的那种。
lines.en: Dropped things are the ones never found.
I picked up three; all for you.
If my cotton fills up, I will sink.
That thing — I will ram it.
I have seen the enemy's eyes.

lines.zh: 缝线绷直，我从上面扎下去。
lines.en: My stitches pull taut; I dive from above.
I can go first; follow behind.
I take to the air where it cannot reach.

lines.zh: 缝线绷紧了，我准备好了。
lines.en: My seams are taut; I am ready.
I will draw it over here.
Leave it to me; I fly fast.
It does not look sturdy.
I am charging in.
I loop around it.
Each time it turns, I switch sides.
I wait for it to raise its arm.

lines.zh: 我的绳子缠住了它的脚。
lines.en: My thread is snagged around its feet.
It has missed twice.
I drift high; it cannot jump to me.
My rag wings beat until I feel dizzy.
I count the beat of its movements.
A little closer and I charge.

lines.zh: 别站在我后面，会挡住我。
lines.en: Do not stand behind me; you block my path.

lines.zh: 它一拳打来，我已在另一侧。
lines.en: It swings a fist, and I am already on the other side.

lines.zh: 这一撞，棉花都飞出来了。
lines.en: The impact sent fluff flying.
I drive it backwards.

lines.zh: 它挥拳，我忽然出现在另一边。
lines.en: It swings, and I am suddenly on the other side.

lines.zh: 我的线绕住了它的手腕。
lines.en: My thread loops its wrist.

lines.zh: 纽扣眼睛被撞掉了一颗。
lines.en: One button eye was knocked off.
I am knocked back and drift right back in.
Again — I have not come apart yet.
My rags scrape across its face.
After the hit I tumble head over heels.

lines.zh: 我从打火石的火星里钻出来。
lines.en: I come out of the spark of flint and steel.
First the threads move, then the rest of me.
I rise and smile at you.
Changing shape feels rather odd.
The fluff scatters and gathers again.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里慢慢浮出来。
lines.en: I float slowly out of the shadow.
My seams have pulled tight again.
I am back, and still yours.
This body works better than the old one.
Do not be afraid; I know you.
Flame is crawling up my cloth.
I hit the ground and bounced twice.

lines.zh: 吸饱水以后，我沉下去了。
lines.en: Once soaked, I sink.
The blast tears me in half.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的棉花。
lines.en: An arrow passed through my cotton.
Something is pulling at my threads.
It has been long since I tasted lava.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的缝线全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning flashed and every seam is singed.
I keep drifting down and cannot stop.
